title: Copy List with Random Pointer
statement: Given the head of a linked list where each node has next and random pointers, return a deep copy of the list.
Each copied node must have the same value and pointer relationships as the original, but no copied node may be one of the original nodes.
constraints: Each random pointer is null or points to a node in the list.
